QuestInfo.name: The Resistance's Decision
QuestInfo.0: Find Claudine in Secret Plaza, Edelstein.
QuestInfo.1: At Secret Plaza, Claudine tells you about Vita's death in an explosion at the mine. In the face of this tragedy, she wants you to tell Kyrin that she will be joining the Alliance.
QuestInfo.2: At Secret Plaza, Claudine told you about Vita's death in an explosion at the mine. She asked you to tell Kyrin that she will be joining the Alliance. Kyrin, pleased with this turn of events, thanked you for your hard work.

0.0: I've been waiting. \r\n#L0##bDid you find Vita?#l\n#k
0.1: I trust you heard the explosion earlier? \r\n#L0##bYes...did something happen?#l\n#k
0.2: Vita... They put a bomb in her. Those Black Wing monsters... When the bomb activated, she left town and headed for the minds. We followed her quick as we could, but...\nWe can't dwell on the past. All that matters is defeating the Black Mage. Tell Kyrin we will join you.

yes.0: I will make the Black Wings pay for what they've done.

1.0: Did you meet with Claudine?\r\n#L0##bYes. The Resistance agreed to join the Alliance.#l\n#k
1.1: Excellent! I knew you were the right person for the job. They'll be a grand addition to the Alliance.

npc.0: Tell Kyrin the Resistance will join her Alliance.
